import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int mod = 998244353;
    static int n;
    static int[] rock1, sci1, paper1;
    static int[] rock2, sci2, paper2;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        rock1 = new int[] {sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt()};
        sci1 = new int[] {sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt()};
        paper1 = new int[] {sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt()};

        rock2 = new int[] {sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt()};
        sci2 = new int[] {sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt()};
        paper2 = new int[] {sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt(), sc.nextInt()};

        System.out.println(minimum() + " " + maximum());
        sc.close();
    }

    static int maximum() {
        int ans = Math.min(rock1[0], sci2[0]) + Math.min(sci1[0], paper2[0]) + Math.min(paper1[0], rock2[0]);
        return ans;
    }

    static int match(int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) return 0;
        if ((a == 1 && b == 2) || (a == 2 && b == 3) || (a == 3 && b == 1))
            return 1;
        return -1;
    }

    static int give(List<int[]> l1, List<int[]> l2) {
        int ans = 0;
        int curr1Count = 0, curr2Count = 0;
        int[] curr1 = null, curr2 = null;
        Stack<int[]> stack1 = new Stack<>();
        Stack<int[]> stack2 = new Stack<>();
        for (int[] val : l1) stack1.push(val);
        for (int[] val : l2) stack2.push(val);
        // Convert to deque for easier pop from end
        ArrayDeque<int[]> dq1 = new ArrayDeque<>(stack1);
        ArrayDeque<int[]> dq2 = new ArrayDeque<>(stack2);

        while (!dq1.isEmpty() || !dq2.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                if (curr1 == null) {
                    curr1 = dq1.pollLast();
                }
                if (curr2 == null) {
                    curr2 = dq2.pollLast();
                }
            } catch (NoSuchElementException e) {
                break;
            }

            int minCount = Math.min(curr1[0], curr2[0]);
            int m = match(curr1[1], curr2[1]);
            ans += Math.max(0, minCount * m);

            if (curr1[0] < curr2[0]) {
                curr2[0] -= curr1[0];
                curr1 = null;
            } else if (curr1[0] > curr2[0]) {
                curr1[0] -= curr2[0];
                curr2 = null;
            } else {
                curr1 = null;
                curr2 = null;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int minimum() {
        int ans = n;
        List<int[]> l = new ArrayList<>();
        l.add(new int[] {rock1[0], 1});
        l.add(new int[] {sci1[0], 2});
        l.add(new int[] {paper1[0], 3});

        List<int[]> l2 = new ArrayList<>();
        l2.add(new int[] {rock2[0], 1});
        l2.add(new int[] {sci2[0], 2});
        l2.add(new int[] {paper2[0], 3});

        List<List<int[]>> permutationsL1 = generatePermutations(l);
        List<List<int[]>> permutationsL2 = generatePermutations(l2);

        int minAns = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (List<int[]> perm1 : permutationsL1) {
            for (List<int[]> perm2 : permutationsL2) {
                List<int[]> list1 = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int[] item : perm1) {
                    list1.add(new int[] {item[0], item[1]});
                }

                List<int[]> list2 = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int[] item : perm2) {
                    list2.add(new int[] {item[0], item[1]});
                }

                minAns = Math.min(minAns, give(list1, list2));
            }
        }
        return minAns;
    }

    static List<List<int[]>> generatePermutations(List<int[]> list) {
        List<List<int[]>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        permute(list, 0, result);
        return result;
    }

    static void permute(List<int[]> arr, int k, List<List<int[]>> result) {
        if (k == arr.size() - 1) {
            List<int[]> temp = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int[] a : arr)
                temp.add(new int[]{a[0], a[1]});
            result.add(temp);
        } else {
            for (int i = k; i < arr.size(); i++) {
                Collections.swap(arr, i, k);
                permute(arr, k + 1, result);
                Collections.swap(arr, i, k);
            }
        }
    }
}
